lines.zh: 我贴着暖水海底滑，肚子蹭着沙。
lines.en: I glide along the warm seabed, belly brushing sand.

lines.zh: 橙色的背在浅水里很显眼，没办法。
lines.en: My orange back stands out in the shallows; so be it.

lines.zh: 奶油色的棘刺挂住了一根海草。
lines.en: A cream thorn snags on a piece of seagrass.

lines.zh: 我巡自己的地盘，一圈又一圈。
lines.en: I patrol my territory, circle after circle.

lines.zh: 别指望我游到上面去，太累。
lines.en: Do not expect me to swim up there; too tiring.

lines.zh: 尾巴一扫，沙里露出一块骨头。
lines.en: One tail sweep uncovers a bone in the sand.

lines.zh: 我走得很低，礁石就在鼻尖前。
lines.en: I travel low, reef rock right before my nose.

lines.zh: 两三条一起巡，队伍排得歪。
lines.en: Two or three patrol together in a crooked line.

lines.zh: 暖水让我懒，但我还是得动。
lines.en: Warm water makes me lazy, but I still must move.

lines.zh: 我的鳍擦过沙面，留下浅沟。
lines.en: My fins brush the sand and leave shallow grooves.

lines.zh: 前面有块平沙，我打算躺一会。
lines.en: There is flat sand ahead; I plan to lie there.

lines.zh: 海龟挡路，我绕着它走。
lines.en: A turtle blocks the way, so I go around it.

lines.zh: 我背上的棘刺碰到珊瑚，咔一声。
lines.en: My back thorns hit coral with a small clack.

lines.zh: 海底的道我熟，闭眼也能走。
lines.en: I know these seabed roads well enough to go blind.

lines.zh: 我顺着暖流走，比划水省力。
lines.en: I ride the warm current; it costs less than swimming.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子挤进珊瑚缝里看了看。
lines.en: I wedge my snout into a coral gap and peek.

lines.zh: 我半埋在沙里，只露出牙齿。
lines.en: I lie half buried in sand with only teeth showing.

lines.zh: 暖水从鳃边过去，很舒服。
lines.en: Warm water passes my gills, and it feels good.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴不动，不是想咬人。
lines.en: I hold my mouth open, not because I want to bite.

lines.zh: 奶油色的棘刺在沙上投下小影子。
lines.en: My cream thorns cast little shadows on the sand.

lines.zh: 这条沟是我昨天趴出来的。
lines.en: This groove is one I pressed out yesterday.

lines.zh: 我懒得追东西，等它自己撞上来。
lines.en: I cannot be bothered to chase; I wait for collisions.

lines.zh: 海底很安静，只有我的牙在响。
lines.en: The seabed is quiet, except for my teeth clicking.

lines.zh: 我把下巴搁在一块石头上。
lines.en: I rest my chin on a flat piece of stone.

lines.zh: 橙色的斑纹在暗处也不显眼。
lines.en: Even my orange patches blend into the gloom.

lines.zh: 有时我会打个哈欠，水就浑了。
lines.en: Sometimes I yawn, and the water turns cloudy.

lines.zh: 我不需要观众，我只要沙。
lines.en: I need no audience; I only need sand.

lines.zh: 有只小蟹爬过我背，我没动。
lines.en: A little crab crawls over my back; I do not move.

lines.zh: 我盯着上方那片亮，看得发呆。
lines.en: I stare at the bright ceiling above until I drift.

lines.zh: 躺着比游着舒服，这是结论。
lines.en: Lying down beats swimming; that is my conclusion.

lines.zh: 我从沙里抬起眼，看着你。
lines.en: I lift my eyes from the sand and look at you.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的沟了，往旁边点。
lines.en: You stepped in my groove; move a little aside.

lines.zh: 我张嘴露牙，只是打个招呼。
lines.en: I bare my teeth, which is just my way of greeting.

lines.zh: 你的脚在水面晃，我看得清楚。
lines.en: Your feet dangle at the surface, and I see them clearly.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转头，棘刺跟着动。
lines.en: I turn my head slowly, and my thorns follow.

lines.zh: 别伸手，我的牙比看起来多。
lines.en: Do not reach out; I have more teeth than I show.

lines.zh: 你潜下来，我们就算面对面了。
lines.en: You dive down, so now we are face to face.

lines.zh: 我认得你那双鞋的底纹。
lines.en: I recognize the tread on those shoes of yours.

lines.zh: 你看我时，我也在秤你多大。
lines.en: While you look at me, I am sizing you up.

lines.zh: 你走了，我把头放回沙上。
lines.en: Once you leave, I put my head back on the sand.

lines.zh: 棘刺断了一根，扎在我自己身上。
lines.en: A thorn breaks off and pricks me instead.

lines.zh: 橙色的皮被划开，露出白肉。
lines.en: My orange skin splits, showing pale flesh.

lines.zh: 这一下把我从沙里掀了出来。
lines.en: That blow lifts me right out of the sand.

lines.zh: 我疼得咬住旁边的石头。
lines.en: I bite the nearest stone to bear the pain.

lines.zh: 牙也磕掉了一颗，真倒霉。
lines.en: One of my teeth chips off too; bad luck.

lines.zh: 我往沙里钻，结果撞到礁石。
lines.en: I try to dig into sand and hit reef rock.

lines.zh: 血在暖水里散成一团橙色。
lines.en: Blood blooms orange in the warm water.

lines.zh: 别踩我受伤的那面鳍。
lines.en: Do not step on the fin that is hurt.

lines.zh: 我翻过身，半天才正回来。
lines.en: I roll over and take ages to right myself.

lines.zh: 海底的日子本来不该这么疼。
lines.en: Life on the seabed should not hurt this much.

lines.zh: 你把鱼丢下来，我懒得抬头。
lines.en: You drop a fish; I cannot be bothered to look up.

lines.zh: 食物落在沙上，得先洗洗。
lines.en: The food lands on sand and needs washing first.

lines.zh: 我闻到血，牙齿自己动了。
lines.en: I smell blood, and my teeth move on their own.

lines.zh: 桶里的水声让我想起浅滩。
lines.en: Water sloshing in a bucket reminds me of the shallows.

lines.zh: 那条鱼太小，塞牙缝都不够。
lines.en: That fish is too small even to pick my teeth.

lines.zh: 你把食物贴着沙推过来，我就吃。
lines.en: Push the food along the sand, and I will eat it.

lines.zh: 我不追，追起来太费力气。
lines.en: I will not chase; chasing costs too much effort.

lines.zh: 暖水里的腥味，比诱饵诚实。
lines.en: The smell of blood in warm water is more honest than bait.

lines.zh: 你晃那条鱼，我只看你的手。
lines.en: You wave the fish; I only watch your hand.

lines.zh: 给我一整条，别切小块。
lines.en: Give me a whole one; do not cut it up.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，先被棘刺扎一下。
lines.en: You bump me and get pricked by thorns first.

lines.zh: 我贴在海床上，像一块沉石。
lines.en: I lie on the seabed like a sunken stone.

lines.zh: 你的脚碰到我的背，我扭了一下。
lines.en: Your foot touches my back, and I twist away.

lines.zh: 两三条小丑鲨挤在一起是常事。
lines.en: Two or three clownthorns crowding is nothing unusual.

lines.zh: 别踢沙，我刚把沟趴平。
lines.en: Do not kick sand; I just smoothed my groove.

lines.zh: 我退得慢，你得自己让开。
lines.en: I move aside slowly, so you had better yield.

lines.zh: 鳍被踩了一下，我抖了抖沙。
lines.en: A fin gets stepped on, and I shake off the sand.

lines.zh: 我们相撞时，牙碰得咔咔响。
lines.en: When we collide, our teeth click and rattle.

lines.zh: 这块礁石我用了三年当枕头。
lines.en: I have used this rock as a pillow for three years.

lines.zh: 撞歪了也不修，反正没人看。
lines.en: If it gets knocked crooked, I leave it; nobody looks.

lines.zh: 两条橙影在沙上并排，慢慢挪。
lines.en: Two orange shadows move side by side over sand.

lines.zh: 它用牙齿轻碰我的牙，很客气。
lines.en: It taps my teeth lightly with its own, politely.

lines.zh: 我们不追不闹，只一起趴着。
lines.en: We do not chase or play; we just lie together.

lines.zh: 暖水里的卵，要埋在细沙下。
lines.en: Eggs in warm water must be buried under fine sand.

lines.zh: 它背上的棘刺比我的短。
lines.en: The thorns on its back are shorter than mine.

lines.zh: 我们绕了两圈，就算定了。
lines.en: We circle twice, and that settles it.

lines.zh: 小鲨出生就会趴沙，天生的。
lines.en: Young sharks lie on sand at birth; it is instinct.

lines.zh: 它把最好的沙沟让给我。
lines.en: It gives me the best sand groove.

lines.zh: 我不叫，只碰碰它的鳍。
lines.en: I do not call out; I only touch its fin.

lines.zh: 分开后，我们各自占一片暖水。
lines.en: When we part, each claims a patch of warm water.

lines.zh: 我用牙叼起骨头，又放回去。
lines.en: I pick up a bone with my teeth and put it back.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西沉下来，我压住它。
lines.en: Whatever you drop sinks, and I pin it down.

lines.zh: 我没有手，只能用嘴推。
lines.en: I have no hands; I can only push with my mouth.

lines.zh: 桶里太窄，我的棘刺卡住了。
lines.en: The bucket is too narrow; my thorns get stuck.

lines.zh: 那颗牙是我换下来的，留着。
lines.en: That tooth is one I shed; I am keeping it.

lines.zh: 我把贝壳摞在沟边，当记号。
lines.en: I stack shells by my groove as markers.

lines.zh: 你递来的鱼，我一口连手都不看。
lines.en: The fish you offer goes down without a glance at you.

lines.zh: 太重，我拖着走了两步就放。
lines.en: Too heavy; I drag it two steps and let go.

lines.zh: 被装进桶，我贴着桶底不动。
lines.en: Bucketed, I press against the bottom and stay still.

lines.zh: 东西掉进我嘴里，那就归我。
lines.en: If it falls into my mouth, then it is mine.

lines.zh: 沙里有什么在动，我抬头。
lines.en: Something moves in the sand, and I raise my head.

lines.zh: 一条鱼游得太低，正好在我前面。
lines.en: A fish swims too low, right in front of me.

lines.zh: 我锁定了那只螃蟹的腿。
lines.en: I have fixed on that crab's legs.

lines.zh: 你的脚在水面拍，我听见了。
lines.en: Your feet slap the surface, and I hear it.

lines.zh: 暖水变浑，说明有东西在挣扎。
lines.en: The warm water muddies, meaning something struggles.

lines.zh: 我不常主动，除非送到眼前。
lines.en: I rarely act first, unless it comes to my nose.

lines.zh: 那片沙鼓起一小块，我盯住。
lines.en: The sand bulges in one spot, and I stare.

lines.zh: 目标不大，但够我挪过去。
lines.en: The target is small but worth shifting over for.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙挪过去，尽量不出声。
lines.en: I slide over the sand, trying to make no sound.

lines.zh: 等它再近一点，我就动。
lines.en: When it comes a little closer, I will move.

lines.zh: 我贴地绕你，像一条橙色的影子。
lines.en: I circle you along the ground like an orange shadow.

lines.zh: 你退，我不追，只跟着挪。
lines.en: You retreat; I do not chase, only shift along.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在沙面上一动不动。
lines.en: My eyes stay motionless above the sand.

lines.zh: 我在等你的脚落下来。
lines.en: I am waiting for your foot to come down.

lines.zh: 嘴张开的角度，我算好了。
lines.en: I have already worked out the angle of my jaw.

lines.zh: 你只要再往前半步。
lines.en: You only need to take half a step forward.

lines.zh: 水流把你的味道送到我鼻前。
lines.en: The current carries your smell to my nose.

lines.zh: 我不亮牙，亮牙会吓跑你。
lines.en: I do not show teeth; that would scare you off.

lines.zh: 这一圈走完，我就决定。
lines.en: When this circle is done, I will decide.

lines.zh: 猎物常以为我只是一块石头。
lines.en: Prey often mistakes me for a piece of rock.

lines.zh: 我从沙里弹起，一口咬住你。
lines.en: I burst up from the sand and bite you.

lines.zh: 牙咬合时，水都震了一下。
lines.en: When my teeth close, the water itself flinches.

lines.zh: 奶油色的棘刺先扎进你手臂。
lines.en: A cream thorn digs into your arm first.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把你拖向沙面。
lines.en: I shake my head and drag you toward the sand.

lines.zh: 这一口是警告，不是开胃。
lines.en: This bite is a warning, not an appetizer.

lines.zh: 我撞你，用整条身体的重量。
lines.en: I ram you with the weight of my whole body.

lines.zh: 你退了，我的牙还留在原地。
lines.en: You pull back, and my teeth stay right there.

lines.zh: 别把手伸进沙里，那是我家。
lines.en: Do not put your hand in the sand; that is my home.

lines.zh: 咬完我落回沟里，像没动过。
lines.en: After biting, I drop back into my groove as if unmoved.

lines.zh: 我的牙不整齐，但咬得紧。
lines.en: My teeth are uneven, but they hold tight.

lines.zh: 暖水海底多了一条橙色的影子。
lines.en: A new orange shadow appears on the warm seabed.

lines.zh: 我从沙里钻出来，先找沟。
lines.en: I emerge from the sand and first look for a groove.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋一裂，我就掉进浅沙。
lines.en: The spawn egg cracks, and I drop into shallow sand.

lines.zh: 我和另一条一起出生，各自散开。
lines.en: I spawn with one other, and we scatter apart.

lines.zh: 棘刺还没长硬，颜色已经橙了。
lines.en: My thorns are still soft, but already orange.

lines.zh: 这片暖水够两条小丑鲨分。
lines.en: This warm water is enough for two clownthorns.

lines.zh: 我第一次趴沙，姿势就很标准。
lines.en: My first lie on the sand was perfectly executed.

lines.zh: 十点生命，够在海底混了。
lines.en: Ten health is enough to get by down here.

lines.zh: 海草替我挡了一会阳光。
lines.en: Seagrass shaded me from the sun for a while.

lines.zh: 我从礁石缝里出来，牙先露头。
lines.en: I come out of a reef crack, teeth first.

lines.zh: 海水滚烫，我的背像被烤过。
lines.en: The seawater boils, and my back feels roasted.

lines.zh: 我摔在礁盘上，牙磕得很响。
lines.en: I crash onto the reef shelf, teeth clacking loudly.

lines.zh: 离开水，我的鳃黏在一起。
lines.en: Out of water, my gills clamp shut and burn.

lines.zh: 爆炸把整片沙掀成了雾。
lines.en: The blast turns the whole sandbed into mist.

lines.zh: 箭从上方扎下来，钉进我背。
lines.en: An arrow stabs down from above into my back.

lines.zh: 咒语让我的牙发麻。
lines.en: Magic makes my teeth go numb and tingle.

lines.zh: 沙里翻不到东西，我越来越瘦。
lines.en: Nothing turns up in the sand, and I grow thin.

lines.zh: 雷打进浅水，我的棘刺全竖了。
lines.en: Lightning enters the shallows, and all my thorns rise.

lines.zh: 我离开海床，下面什么都没有。
lines.en: I leave the seabed, and there is nothing below.
